name: statistical-mechanics
description: Use this skill when the user says 'diffusion model math', 'score matching', 'DDPM', 'Langevin dynamics', 'reverse SDE', 'probability flow ODE', 'Boltzmann distribution', 'energy-based model', 'classifier-free guidance', 'flow matching', 'noise schedule'. Explains the statistical-mechanics view of generative modeling (Boltzmann distributions, Langevin dynamics, forward/reverse diffusion SDEs, score functions) and implements a correct DDPM training and sampling loop. Do NOT use for: using pretrained image generators (ai/genai-vision), information-theoretic losses (fundamental-truths/information-theory), or physics simulation in games.
